name: Create Device Request
description: Place a FHIR DeviceRequest to order or authorise a medical device (e.g. wheelchair, CPAP, blood glucose monitor) for the current patient.

intent_examples: Request a wheelchair for the patient
when_to_use: User wants to order or request a medical device for a patient
User wants to create a FHIR DeviceRequest
User is placing a durable medical equipment (DME) order
when_not_to_use: User wants to order medication (use create_medication_request instead)
User wants to order a procedure or lab (use create_service_request instead)
User wants to record an immunization (use record_immunization instead)
User wants to view existing device orders

introduction: I'll help you place a device request order. Search for the device type using SNOMED CT, then classify the order and assign a requester.

completion.message: Device request placed successfully. The order has been recorded in the patient's FHIR record.

workflow_steps.name: Place Device Request
workflow_steps.description: Search for the device type, select status and intent, and optionally assign a requester.

context_resolvers.description: Resolve the logged-in user's Patient record so patient_id is available automatically.
Fetch allowed status codes for DeviceRequest.
Fetch allowed intent codes for DeviceRequest.
Load practitioners available for booking to populate the requester select.
